transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I just haven’t been doing much of anything. I stay in my room most of the time, same clothes and everything. I used to knit, write in my journal, go on walks, but I just… don’t. When my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely feel like answering.
How long has it been since you started feeling this way and pulling back from activities like knitting or journaling?
Um… I think it started around when I began the community college program. So… a little over two years ago. Maybe two years and a couple months.
Over these past two years, has this low, withdrawn feeling been present pretty much every day without a break, or have there been stretches—weeks or months—where you felt back to your normal self?
I don’t think there’s really been a normal stretch. It’s kind of just been like this since I started that community college thing… about two years and a couple months ago.

During these past two years, has there been a period of at least two weeks when things felt noticeably worse than your usual baseline—for example, with more trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, or feeling especially worthless or hopeless?
I’m… not really sure. It’s all kind of blended together, so I can’t tell if there was a clear two-week stretch that was worse. I haven’t really kept track.
Right now, are you also noticing things like trouble sleeping, changes in your appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, or feeling excessively guilty or worthless?

Mostly… I just don’t really do anything. I sit in my room a lot, same clothes on, and I can’t make myself knit or journal or go walking like I used to. When my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely feel like answering.
Would you say you're feeling unusually tired or low on energy nearly every day right now?
Yeah… I guess so. It’s more like I just can’t get myself to do anything. I’ll sit in my room in the same clothes, and even answering my mom feels like too much sometimes.
Right now, are you having trouble sleeping—either sleeping much more or much less than usual?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying that much attention to it.
During this time, have you ever felt like you were worthless, or blamed yourself for things in a way that felt excessive or unfair?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it like that. I just feel kind of blank, I guess.
Looking back over these two years, has there been any specific stretch of time when your mood or lack of motivation felt distinctly worse or more intense than it does most of the time, even briefly?

I don’t know if there was, like, one stretch. It’s mostly just been… I can’t make myself do anything anymore. I sit in my room in the same clothes, and I don’t really knit or write in my journal or go walking like I used to. When my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely feel like answering.
Lately, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making even simple decisions, like what to eat or wear?
I’m not sure. I don’t really… think about it that way. Sometimes I just don’t decide, I guess.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight—eating a lot more or less than usual?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track. I just eat when there’s something there, I guess… I haven’t noticed my weight or anything.
Have you had any thoughts lately that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of death or wanting to hurt yourself?
I don’t know… not really. I don’t think about hurting myself. I just… don’t think much about anything, I guess.
Have you or your mom noticed that you're moving, talking, or thinking more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah… maybe. My mom says I take forever to answer sometimes. Mostly I just sit in my room and don’t really do anything. Same clothes, not knitting or writing or going outside like before. When she asks me what’s wrong, I just… I don’t have much to say.
Before these past two years started, had you ever gone through an earlier period—at any point in your life—where you felt this same kind of low, unmotivated, withdrawn way for two weeks or more?

I don’t think so… not like this. I mean, I’ve had times where I didn’t want to do much, but now it’s more like I just can’t make myself do anything. I sit in my room, wear the same clothes, don’t knit or write or go walking anymore… I don’t remember it being this bad before.
Over the past two weeks specifically, would you say you're sleeping more than usual, less than usual, or about the same as before?
I’m not really sure… I haven’t been paying much attention. Maybe about the same? I don’t know.
I don’t really know… I haven’t been keeping track. It’s probably not that different, I guess.
Setting aside the trouble getting motivated, would you say you feel sad, empty, or hopeless inside on most days?
I don’t know… I don’t really think about it like that. Maybe kind of blank sometimes, but I’m not sure.
Has this low, unmotivated state caused you to miss classes, fall behind in your coursework, or struggle with basic daily tasks like showering or eating regularly?
Yeah… I guess it has. I kind of had to stop moving forward with the certificate program. I can’t really handle the practicum right now, or… plan for that clinic office job I was trying to get to.
Over the last two weeks, would you say that the low energy, slowed thinking, and loss of interest you described have all been happening together, nearly every day, at the same time?

Yeah… I think so. Most days it’s just all kind of there. I mostly just sit in my room, same clothes on, and I don’t really do the stuff I used to—like knitting or journaling or walking. If my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely feel like answering.
Um… sorry, I’m not sure what you’re asking. Could you say it again?
